title: Act: Add sound and settings flags and toggles to uiStore.ts
summary: Extend UiState with soundEnabled, settingsOpen, toggleSound, toggleSettings.
description: Add sound and settings fields and actions to the store created in uiStore.ts.
acceptance_criteria: soundEnabled defaults true, settingsOpen defaults false
Toggles flip only their own flag
dependencies: Act: Create uiStore.ts with drawer and modal state and actions

steps.action: Add soundEnabled: boolean and settingsOpen: boolean plus toggleSound and toggleSettings to the UiState interface; add initial soundEnabled: true, settingsOpen: false and the two toggle actions to the create initializer.
steps.code:
soundEnabled: true,
settingsOpen: false,
toggleSound: () => set((s) => ({ soundEnabled: !s.soundEnabled })),
toggleSettings: () => set((s) => ({ settingsOpen: !s.settingsOpen })),
steps.expected: Store exposes sound and settings state and actions
